page_title: TOU 1-2 NAN | Toulouse v Nantes 11/02/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+8' The match has just finished.
90+5' 1 - 2 Thijs Dallinga (Toulouse) scores from a quite difficult position as he leaps high to connect with a cross and powers his header low inside the left post. Excellent finish.
90+5' The resulting corner comes to nothing as Stijn Spierings (Toulouse) sends it out of play.
90+4' Stijn Spierings (Toulouse) swings in a dangerous cross from the resulting corner kick, but none of his teammates manage to outjump the defence. Toulouse win a corner.

90+4' Toulouse are playing possession football and controlling the game at present. They are exchanging inch-perfect passes from player to player, making it difficult for the opposition to win the ball.

90+1' Shavy Babicka (Toulouse) unleashed a monstrous piledriver. He controlled a pass, glanced up at goal and shot from the edge of the box. It could have been a difficult one for the keeper, but the ball fortunately hit one of the defenders and ball bounced away.
90' 7 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
88' Alban Lafont (Nantes) is clearly asking for some medical attention with his painful gestures. The extent of his injury is yet to be discovered.
86' Ibrahim Cissoko (Toulouse) is unable to feed an accurate cross into the box. The ball goes out of play and Nantes will have a goal kick.
81' It is time for a substitution. Enzo Mongo (Nantes) is on for Jean-Kevin Duverne.
81' Tino Kadewere goes off the pitch and Hugo Boutsingkham (Nantes) comes on.
80' Here is a change. Niklas Schmidt is going off and Carles Martinez gives the last tactical orders to Naatan Skytta (Toulouse).
80' A substitution has been made. Gabriel Suazo goes off and Ibrahim Cissoko (Toulouse) comes on.
80' Substitution. Matthis Abline (Nantes) on for Mostafa Mohamed.
76' Thijs Dallinga (Toulouse) goes down in the box after a challenge from the defender. Possibly unsighted, the referee just waves play on.
75' The referee looks satisfied after his VAR review and duly disallows the goal for offside. The Toulouse players look gutted.
74' Wait! Referee Gael Angoula has indicated he is going to review the Toulouse goal using VAR. It’s probably to see if there was an offside in the build-up.
73' Goal! Frank Magri (Toulouse) is quickest to react to the rebound and stabs the ball into the back of the net. It's 1:2.
72' Mikkel Desler (Toulouse) tries to create a chance, but puts too much weight on his pass. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Nantes.
71' Substitution. Marcus Coco leaves the pitch and is replaced by Nicolas Cozza (Nantes).
70' A pass by Shavy Babicka (Toulouse) ends up in no man's land, and the attacking effort comes to an end.
69' Toulouse enjoy a period of possession as they are exchanging some passes and waiting for an opportunity to strike.
65' Jocelyn Gourvennec has decided to make a change. Stredair Appuah (Nantes) replaces Benie Traore.
64' Mostafa Mohamed (Nantes) is down injured and the referee stops play so that he can receive medical treatment.
60' Substitution. Vincent Sierro did his best and is replaced by Stijn Spierings (Toulouse).
60' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Frank Magri (Toulouse) replaces Aron Donnum.
60' Carles Martinez prepares a substitution. Christian Mawissa Elebi is replaced by Logan Costa (Toulouse).
59' Vincent Sierro (Toulouse) is about to take a corner kick.
59' Vincent Sierro (Toulouse) whips in the resulting set piece but it's cleared.
56' Vincent Sierro (Toulouse) works the corner short instead of sending the ball into the penalty area.

55' Vincent Sierro (Toulouse) takes the resultant free kick from the edge of the box and tries to find one of his teammates with a cross, but the keeper climbs high and gets to it first, collecting the ball with ease.
54' Marcus Coco (Nantes) makes an overly-aggressive challenge and Gael Angoula blows his whistle for a foul. Toulouse get a free kick.
51' 0 - 2 Tino Kadewere (Nantes) received a delightful pass inside the box before slotting the ball past the goalkeeper. What a brilliant finish!
50' Vincent Sierro (Toulouse) takes the corner but fails to find any of his teammates.
49' Vincent Sierro (Toulouse) takes the corner but fails to find any of his teammates. The ball is easily cleared out of danger. Toulouse have a corner.
48' Mostafa Mohamed (Nantes) crosses the ball into the box from the free kick, but the defence clears the danger.

47' Marcus Coco (Nantes) pulls the jersey of one of the opposition players and Gael Angoula blows his whistle for a foul. It's a free kick to Toulouse, but they probably won't attempt a direct shot on goal from here.
46' The half-time break is over and the second half is about to start.
45+5' The end of the first half.
45+4' Thijs Dallinga (Toulouse) finds himself beyond the last defender, but the game is stopped by the referee after the linesman signals for offside.
45+1' Gael Angoula shows a yellow card to Moussa Sissoko (Nantes) for a tough tackle.
45+1' Gabriel Suazo (Toulouse) is clearly asking for some medical attention with his painful gestures. The extent of his injury is yet to be discovered.
45' We will have 4 min. of added time.
45' Moussa Sissoko (Nantes) requires medical treatment, so the referee stops play and signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
43' The game is interrupted now, Mostafa Mohamed (Nantes) picks up a knock and the physio has to come on.
41' A yellow card for a tackle by Yann Gboho (Toulouse). Gael Angoula doesn't hesitate at all to make this decision.
38' Vincent Sierro (Toulouse) takes the corner which is cleared by the opposition's defence.
33' The Toulouse players are exchanging some short passes.
26' The corner from Niklas Schmidt (Toulouse) is intercepted by Alban Lafont.
26' A cross from Mikkel Desler (Toulouse) fails to reach the box as the defence clears the ball away to safety. Toulouse will take a corner kick.
22' Niklas Schmidt (Toulouse) takes the corner, but it's intercepted by the defender.
20' Mostafa Mohamed (Nantes) connects with a cross near the penalty spot and produces a decent header which rattles the left post!
19' Vincent Sierro (Toulouse) can't expect anything else than a yellow card for his hard tackle. And a yellow it is. Gael Angoula didn't think twice about pulling it out of his pocket.
15' Shavy Babicka (Toulouse) breaks into the box and goes over after a challenge from an opposition player, but the ref signals NO penalty!
13' Gabriel Suazo (Toulouse) swings in the corner, but it's comfortably cleared away.

12' Thijs Dallinga (Toulouse) collects a pass and finds himself in a good position to strike from the edge of the box, but his attempt is blocked. The referee blows his whistle, Toulouse are awarded a corner kick.
9' Niklas Schmidt (Toulouse) steps up to take the corner, but the ball just sails in among the defenders.

9' Vincent Sierro (Toulouse) reacts well to get to the rebound and takes a shot from the edge of the box, but he fails to get the ball through the players standing between him and the goal. The referee points to the corner flag. It's a corner to Toulouse.
9' A quickly taken corner by Toulouse.

5' Thijs Dallinga (Toulouse) has a big opportunity! He finds some space for a shot inside the penalty box after collecting a lofted pass and sends the ball narrowly over the crossbar. The ball goes out of play and Nantes will have a goal kick.

2' 0 - 1 Mostafa Mohamed (Nantes) displays what a brilliant free kick master he is, especially from this distance. He hits the ball very well and scores with a low shot inside the left post, leaving the keeper helpless.
1' Mostafa Mohamed (Nantes) takes a direct free kick.
1' The first half has started.
The players are on the pitch and Nantes will have the kick-off.
Gael Angoula will supervise the game today.
